en: A sepia-toned photograph of a grand, neoclassical building with a clock tower, statues on the rooftop, and a garden or park in the foreground. There are a few people walking or standing in front of the building. The card features text in multiple languages at the top left: 'Pori,' 'Björneborg,' 'Raatihuone,' and 'Rådhuset.' Above the entrance, the building’s pediment is inscribed with 'Curia Arctopolis.'
